content: दिव् I. €4 <ab>P.</ab> (दीव्यति, द्यूत or द्यून; {%<ab>desid.</ab>%} दुद्यूषति, दिदेविषति) .²1 To shine, be bright; दीव्यत्युच्चैर्लघुरघुपतिः किं नु वा स्यात् किमन्यत् <ls>Mv. 6. 53</ls>. .²2 To throw, cast (as a missile); अदीव्यद्रौद्रमत्युग्रम् <ls>Bk. 17. 87</ls>, <ls n="Bk.">5. 81</ls>. .²2 To gamble, play with dice (with <ab>acc.</ab> or <ab>instr.</ab> of the ‘dice’); अक्षैरक्षान् वा दीव्यति <ls>Sk.</ls>; <ls>Śi. 8. 32</ls>; <ls>Ve. 1. 13</ls>. .²4 To play, sport. .²5 To joke, trifle with, make sport of, rally (with <ab>acc.</ab>). .²6 To stake, make a bet. .²7 To sell, deal in (with <ab>gen.</ab>); अदेवीद्बन्धुभोगानाम् <ls>Bk. 8. 122</ls>; (but with <ab>acc.</ab> or <ab>gen.</ab> when the root is preceded by a preposition; शतं शतस्य वा परिदीव्यति <ls>Sk.</ls>) .²8 To squander, make light of. .²9 To praise. .²10 To be glad, rejoice. .²11 To be mad or drunk. .²12 To be sleepy. .²13 To wish for. --II. €1 <ab>P.</ab>, €10 <ab>U.</ab> (देवति, देवयति-ते) .²1 To cause to lament, pain, vex, torment. .²2 To ask, beg. --III. €10 <ab>Ā.</ab> (देवयते) To suffer pain, lament, moan. --{%With%} परि to lament, moan, suffer pain; खरदूषणयोर्भ्रात्रोः पर्यदेविष्ट सा पुरः <ls>Bk. 4. 34</ls>.

दिव् {%f.%} [दिव्यन्त्यत्र दिव्-बा˚ आधारे डिवि <ls>Tv.</ls>] (<ab>Nom.</ab> <ab>sing.</ab> द्यौः) .²1 The heaven; दिवं मरुत्वानिव भोक्ष्यते भुवम् <ls>R. 3. 4</ls>, <ls n="R. 3.">12</ls>; <ls>Me. 30</ls>. .²2 The sky; दिव्यन्तरिक्षे भूमौ च घोरमुत्पातजं भयम् <ls>Rām. 2. 1. 43</ls>. .²3 A day; अत्र भोक्तव्यमस्माभिर्दिवारूढं क्षुधार्दिताः <ls>Bhāg. 10. 13. 6</ls>. .²4 Light, brilliance. .²5 Fire, glow of fire. {%<ab>N. B.</ab>%} The compounds with दिव् as first member are mostly irregular; {%<ab>e. g.</ab>%} दिवस्पतिः an epithet of Indra (of the 13th मन्वन्तर); <ls>Bhāg. 8. 13. 32</ls>; अनतिक्रमणीया दिवस्पतेराज्ञा <ls>Ś. 6</ls>; दिवस्पृथिव्यौ heaven and earth. दिविज्ञः, दिविष्ठः, दिविस्थः, दिविस(ष)द् {%m.%}, {@दिवोकस्@} {%m.%}, {@दिवौकस्, -सः@} ‘inhabitant of the heaven’, a god; <ls>Ś. 7</ls>; <ls>R. 3. 19</ls>, <ls n="R. 3.">47</ls>; दिविषद्वृन्दैः <ls>Gīt. 7</ls>. {@दिवस्पृश@} {%m.%} the Supreme Being. {@दिविस्पृश्@} {%a.%} reaching or pervading the sky. {@दिवोद्भवा@} cardamoms. {@दिवोल्का@} a meteor. {@दिवौकस्@} {%m.%} .²1 a god. .²2 the Chātaka bird. .²3 a deer. .²4 a bee. .²5 an elephant.
